text:
ana (Finance): Morning — automated cost alert showed a sharp overnight increase in Dedicated GPU spend for us-west-2. Dashboard shows large portion as UNASSIGNED. https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h

billing-bot: :warning: Anomaly detected: dedicated-pool surge (+21%). Notifying #finance #eng-platform

matt (FinOps): I queried the billing export — several instances from project trial-zenith-09 are missing billing labels (team, cost_center). Rough estimate impact ~USD 9.8k over last 10 hours.

rui (Platform): That project got new onboarding logic yesterday to support ephemeral dedicated pools. Looks like we forgot to pass billing metadata in one code path. Working on a patch; ETA ~30m.

ana (Finance): Can we retro-attribute costs? We need to know whether to bill the trial or absorb.

casey (Sales): Trial terms say we manage the infra but have a usage cap. I'll check with the customer and share any written consent for bookkeeping changes.

matt (FinOps): Backfill approach: 1) list instance IDs from export 2) add labels via gcloud 3) trigger billing re-ingestion. Example commands (dry-run first):
```
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql 'SELECT resource.labels.instance_id FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage` WHERE project_id="trial-zenith-09" AND usage_start_time > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)'
# then
gcloud compute instances add-labels $ID --labels=team=zenith,cost_center=trial-zenith --project=trial-zenith-09 --zone=us-west2-a --quiet
```

sara (Legal): Please hold on modifying customer-side metadata without explicit written permission unless the contract allows it. Sales, get a quick email thread okaying attribution.

rui (Platform): I pushed the fix to onboarding service and created an alert 'dedicated-unlabeled-launch' to notify #finance on future unlabeled launches. PR: https://git.internal/onboarding/pull/690

billing-bot: Deploy succeeded: onboarding-service v1.2.9 at 03:18 UTC

matt (FinOps): I'll prepare the instance list and wait for Sales/Legal sign-off before running backfill. Leaving thread open until reconciled. :white_check_mark:
